senses.gloss: f. (v. חָף) fish remaining on the shore after the water receded, mud-fish.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:4:7">Cant. R. to I, 4</cite> (ref. to <he>תדוץ דאבה</he>, <cite ref="Job 41:14">Job XLI, 14</cite>, cmp. <cite ref="D00005"><he>דָּאַב</he></cite>) <he>מקרטעא כהדא ח׳</he> jumping like raked fish.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:9:3">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 42ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="H01457"><he>חָפִיתָה</he></cite>; cmp. <cite ref="H00851"><he>חִיפּוּשָׁא</he></cite>.
